title: Game Development — From Movement Playground to a Finished Indie Game
subtitle: Sequenced Odin-style courses with accountable exercises, full-game production and optional specializations
audience: Professional backend/CS programmer beginning independent game development with Godot and GDScript
learning_policy: Follow the recommended course order, but move between optional specializations freely. Apply concepts in two ways: guided implementation and independent transfer. Technical docs are allowed.
content_definition: Every lesson has a concept explanation, two concrete assignments, a knowledge check and a curated reading reference. This is a complete actionable curriculum, not textbook-length lessons or verified courseware.
quality_standard: Each lesson teaches an explicit idea, links to focused reading, names common failure modes and tests observable outcomes; course projects require independent integration.
progress_migration: Existing lesson and assignment IDs preserved. New courses/lessons have additive IDs.
notes_on_time: Estimates describe structured study effort only. Capstone full production is open-ended and not included in promised time-to-release.
